name: bootstrap-reassert
description: Re-apply the re-assertable bootstrap elements on every run, so a unit converges on the current bootstrap without anyone carrying a USB stick to it. Runs client/bootstrap.ps1 -ReassertOnly, which applies the 'routine' elements only: 'console' elements are first touch and stay untouched, 'on-demand' elements (the two that re-assert the transport) run only when named by hand, and 'provider' elements are owned by their own provider. Does not stamp bootstrap_version -- see docs/decisions/2026-08-24-a-re-assert-run-does-not-claim-the-unit-is-bootstrapped.md.
